verdict.rationale: Carta documents law-firm-specific API use cases. Law firms can fetch cap table information on behalf of a company and programmatically send new customers to Carta. Draft APIs, such as draft option grants and draft issuers, could support preparing records. However, nothing shows outside counsel working directly in the platform under dedicated law-firm roles or permissions. missing for 10: in-platform law-firm/counsel role and permission model, document preparation workflows for counsel, evidence of counsel updating records directly in the UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
